rule: WAITING is line-specific and never means mission IDLE or DONE. Blocked work registers its dependency and the mission continues with the highest-priority non-blocked item.

items.objective: Reconcile current feature-branch state with source-main mission evidence and current Git/PR/CI state.
items.problem: Current branch and source-main architecture remain distinct evidence layers.
items.authorized_action: Maintain explicit source-of-truth reconciliation and prevent unsupported promotion.
acceptance_criteria: No mission claimed operational solely from stale docs
items.validation_method: Git ref/commit inspection + registry validation + CI/PR inspection + persisted reconciliation

items.objective: Implement persistent append-only state-transition/event lineage with concurrency protection.
items.problem: Initial event primitives needed persistent and serialized writes.
items.authorized_action: Continue reconciling seeded materialized registries with canonical event identities and require event-backed mutation for every mutable writer.
acceptance_criteria: seeded projections are linked to event identities where evidence exists
items.validation_method: unit + adversarial tamper/order/replay/concurrency tests + CI + projection/event reconciliation

items.objective: Extend zero-context bootstrap from validation into deterministic event-state replay.
items.problem: Replay was initially absent; the event stream now has a deterministic replay engine and atomic event creation, but full migration of every mutable registry write to event production remains incomplete.
items.authorized_action: Integrate replay as the canonical reconstruction path for every mutable registry and state transition.
acceptance_criteria: all mutable control-plane writes emit replayable events

items.objective: Close the gap between repository-side authority contracts and actual platform/runtime enforcement.
items.problem: Repository-side controls and active protected-main ruleset are evidenced; non-bypassable root authority and complete coverage of every mission surface remain external/unverified.
items.authorized_action: Audit remaining protected surfaces and persist the external root-of-trust boundary; do not represent the configured bypass actor as non-bypassable protection.
items.validation_method: source/security audit + adversarial tests + GitHub ruleset evidence

items.objective: Demonstrate concurrent mission execution without lost state, duplicate claims or contradictory commits.
items.problem: Component-level and deterministic multi-process coordination is tested, but external independent mission execution remains unverified.
items.authorized_action: Extend concurrent fixtures to cover handoff integration and materialized-state CAS/reconciliation across independent mission identities.
items.validation_method: multi-process adversarial tests + CI + replay evidence

items.objective: Execute all persisted control-plane adversarial scenarios and prevent NOT_EXECUTED from being promoted to PASS.
items.problem: The 20-scenario matrix has executable tests for registry consistency, authorization loss and repository-head divergence; current control-plane CI passes the complete command and bootstrap.
items.authorized_action: Resolve remaining scenarios whose test coverage is descriptive rather than full end-to-end platform behavior.

items.objective: Inspect existing warning, decision and action consumers before implementing response-coupling ledger functionality.
items.problem: Operational effectiveness requires linking warning, decision, response exposure and outcome ascertainment without duplicating existing contracts.
items.authorized_action: Source-inspect warning/decision/action consumers and existing persistence; produce response-coupling audit and only then implement justified ledger changes.
items.validation_method: source inspection + contract audit + adversarial tests + scientific consistency audit
